children: Primark, the international fashion retailer, known for its affordable style and everyday essentials has announced the opening dates of its first stores in Bahrain and Qatar in partnership with Alshaya Group.
Primark will open its doors at City Centre Bahrain on September 23, followed by its Qatar launch at Doha Festival City on October 29.
Both openings will bring Primark's vibrant in-store energy to new customers, combining trend-led fashion, everyday essentials and unbeatable value, said a statement from the company.

Opening day celebrations are set to reflect the energy and excitement Primark is known for, with entertainment, giveaways and activations designed to create a memorable shopping journey for customers, it stated.
The brand will also continue to invest in its existing UAE footprint through the addition of a second floor within the Mall of the Emirates store, scheduled to open in November 2026.

The expanded space will introduce a significantly larger menswear and Primark Home offering, while increasing capacity across the first floor to provide customers with a wider selection and greater availability of products across womenswear, kidswear, accessories and beauty.

Ghansham Pindoria, Vice President of Primark Middle East: "We're incredibly excited to introduce the Primark experience to customers in Bahrain and Qatar for the very first time. These openings are more than just launching new stores; they're about creating exciting destinations where customers can discover fashion, beauty and homeware at exceptional value."
"We're grateful to the many customers who have patiently waited for Primark to arrive - we can't wait to welcome them to our amazing stores," he stated.

Looking ahead, Primark's expansion across the GCC is set to continue into 2027, including a new location in Kuwait at Aventura Mall and a second store in Qatar at Villaggio Mall, further strengthening the brand's presence across existing markets and bringing Primark to even more communities throughout the region.-

title: ZAWYA: Fashion retailer Primark gears up for Bahrain, Qatar launch
